scope: Shared subscription tree contract and source-based selector reconstruction; not a complete original host/runtime parity claim.

claims.front: Native SDK connection IDs populate PreModules; recursively walk graph predecessors with deduplication, append non-solution parent. Tree holder ordering is by DisplayNameA, independent of node storage/display order.
claims.parent: Parent candidate contributes Inputs rather than Outputs, and Group LoopIndex may additionally appear for int.
claims.leafFilter: Requested exact native type; CanSubscribeA; Visible; timestamp exclusions; exclude private except parent. Preserve BuildFilterTreePath hierarchy.
claims.referenceIdentity: Original trees carry VmIO/Holder target objects. The original UI formats paths for transport; independent code retains typed Procedure/Node/Port/variable/channel identity separately from localized caption and presentation. No caption parsing is used to discover a new identity.
claims.domains: Input IO association mutates RelateIO and RelateIndex. Parameter subscription uses ParamSubManager with separate paramName/type, source kind and index kind. These are distinct contracts.
claims.indexes: All, literal and reference index have distinct typed representation. Constant input validation follows original int/float/double/string; original float/double rejects NaN but permits Infinity, which a strict host may explicitly reject.
claims.uiState: RadioSelecter no-r reads IUserData Param.+ComName; no-w setter writes it. Numeric subscribe/edit mode separately uses @+ComName and clears parameter binding when returning to edit.
claims.ui: ButtonSelecter_sub is editable/deletable text plus 32px link popup with 180x180 hierarchical SubTreeView; leaves invoke typed source-object selection. Text focus inside brackets offers integer-index tree. Independent controls retain hierarchy/typed identity and source image assets; full pixel parity has not been verified.
